name: Forget Me Not
source:
In 1925, two young men sit down to have coffee together. Both are tied together by a memory that one would rather forget.

[From [url=https://leoniebeetle.itch.io/forget-me-not]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1925年，两个年轻人坐下来一起喝咖啡。两者都被一种人们宁愿忘记的记忆联系在一起。

[来自[url=https://leoniebeetle.itch.io/forget-me-not]Itch.io[/url]]
